tools.name: devops_config-hardening-grade
tools.description: Grade a caller-supplied Dockerfile, Kubernetes YAML document, or Terraform JSON file for root execution, exposed ports, missing resource limits, and insecure defaults. Parsing stays in memory. The file is not applied, fetched, or stored. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/devops/config-hardening-grade.

tools.name: devops_deployment-blast-radius
tools.description: Walk a caller-supplied service dependency graph from proposed changes and list upstream and downstream services that may be affected. No CI/CD system is contacted. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/devops/deployment-blast-radius. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: devops_rollback-feasibility-check
tools.description: Evaluate whether a proposed deployment can be rolled back using supplied versions, migration reversibility, compatibility constraints, and recovery procedures. No deployment platform is queried. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/devops/rollback-feasibility-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment

tools.name: devops_release-readiness-audit
tools.description: Check whether a release meets supplied operational requirements: prerequisites, monitoring coverage, rollback plans, and unresolved blockers. Returns concrete gaps rather than a generic risk score. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/devops/release-readiness-audit. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "devops" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: devops_deployment-blast-radius, devops_rollback-feasibility-check, devops_release-readiness-audit · Private data: devops_config-hardening-grade · Public sink: devops_config-hardening-grade, devops_deployment-blast-radius, devops_rollback-feasibility-check, devops_release-readiness-audit · Destructive: devops_config-hardening-grade, devops_deployment-blast-radius, devops_rollback-feasibility-check, devops_release-readiness-audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: devops_deployment-blast-radius, devops_rollback-feasibility-check, devops_release-readiness-audit · Private data: devops_config-hardening-grade · Public sink: devops_config-hardening-grade, devops_deployment-blast-radius, devops_rollback-feasibility-check, devops_release-readiness-audit · Destructive: devops_config-hardening-grade, devops_deployment-blast-radius, devops_rollback-feasibility-check, devops_release-readiness-audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
